name: Maaya 2
overview: This is an Indian GL web series staring Leela Jumani and Priyal Gor which came out in 2018. The premise of Maaya 2 is that a girl named Ruhi falls in love with another girl named Simmi.Ruhi learns that Simmi is her boss, Puneet Tandon's fiancee and that Puneet is very abusive. Ruhi tries to save Simmi from Punnet and in the process, Simmi falls in love with Ruhi. Maaya 2 is the second season of Maaya but the story is not related. Maaya is also not GL while Maaya is.
